ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits: Decade #1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A country hits collection could suit my interest in 747 and Golden, but I would choose vocal music today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lifer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize enough from the title to connect it with my current listening interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: Guardians of the Galaxy; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy some soundtracks, but this does not suggest the gentle orchestral mood I want today.
ItemID: NA; Title: How Great Is Our God: The Essential Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent listening does not establish an interest in worship music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Home for Christmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It connects with my Christmas listening, but I am not choosing seasonal music this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in classical crossover vocals than a contemporary pop album right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wicked Game; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: If this is the Il Divo album, it closely matches my enjoyment of A Musical Affair and Amor & Pasion.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blown Away; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits the country side of my listening, but I would prioritize smoother vocal music today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Il Volo; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The classical crossover vocals strongly fit my interest in Under One Sky, Stages, and Lead With Your Heart.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Soundtrack of My Life; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough reason to expect the orchestral or vocal style I want.
